gloss: ecology, mode of life, behavior (of organisms)

definitions.gloss: ecology, mode of life, behavior (of organisms)
definitions.explanation: The way organisms live and interact with their environment. Encompasses their habits, diet, reproduction, and relationship with their surroundings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野鳥|やちょう}→野鳥：14497_yachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生態|せいたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}する→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: To observe the ecology of wild birds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深海|しんかい}→深海：16050_shinkai⟧{魚|ぎょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生態|せいたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧わかって⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The ecology of deep-sea fish is still not well understood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたるフィールドワーク⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦ゴリラ→ゴリラ：06513_gorira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生態|せいたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になってきた。
examples.english: Through many years of fieldwork, the ecology of gorillas has gradually come to light.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used in scientific and documentary contexts. Often forms compounds with ⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧ to make ⟦{生態系|せいたいけい}→生態系：04626_seitaikei⟧ (ecosystem), which is one of the most frequent uses of this word. Can also be used figuratively about human groups (e.g., the "ecology" of a workplace).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{生態系|せいたいけい}→生態系：04626_seitaikei⟧: ecosystem
- ⟦{生態学|せいたいがく}→生態学：09967_seitaigaku⟧: ecology (the academic discipline)
- {生態調査|せいたいちょうさ}: ecological survey

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生態|せいたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}する→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧: to observe ecology/behavior
- {生態|せいたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to study ecology
- {生態|せいたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: ecology becomes clear
- {生態|せいたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解明|かいめい}する→解明する：26852_kaimeisuru⟧: to elucidate ecology
